title: $1,000,000 AI Automation Agency in 30 days - Day 1
summary: Day one of a challenge to build a million-dollar-a-year AI automation agency in 30 days with no-code tools, a small budget and a borrowed offer framework.

assertions.quote: that's why I decided to start this challenge of building a million dollar AI automation agency in 30 days

verdicts.note: New service agencies take months or years to sign clients; a month-one seven-figure run rate is far outside any base rate.

assertions.quote: I would need around 20 clients each paying me around four thousand a month

verdicts.note: Off-the-shelf chatbot and automation tools cost tens to hundreds a month, so few small businesses pay agency retainers in the thousands for them.

assertions.quote: I am targeting coaches Consultants that includes Fitness Wellness as well real estate and e-commerce businesses
I will only use no code or low code tools for my services I want to make this method as accessible and doable for everyone
these days I work anywhere from 12 to 15 hours and I love it
the amount of work expands to fill the time available for its completion

verdicts.note: Deadlines do curb procrastination, but planning-fallacy research shows tight deadlines are routinely missed and can cut quality.
